wiki.title: J. D. Scholten
wiki.extract: James Dennis Scholten (born March 4, 1980) is an American politician and former minor league baseball player. He is from the state of Iowa, and is a member of the Iowa House of Representatives for District 1. Scholten was the Democratic nominee for Iowa's 4th congressional district in the 2018 and 2020 elections. Scholten will not run for re-election at the end of his term and will retire from the Iowa House.
